decisions.briefing: Markets were nearly flat today: the NASDAQ fell 0.1% and the S&P 500 fell 0.2%. Cash is $445.88, which is below the $500 buy threshold, and there was no clear risk-on signal, so we are holding all 7 positions. We are keeping the 3 open slots and the cash in reserve for a stronger day. ASX, AEHR, AXSM and NOK are top of the watchlist because all four buy signals line up.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks barely moved today, with the NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, which looks like a pause rather than a change in direction. Momentum stayed mixed underneath: chip and semiconductor-equipment names like ASX and AEHR kept rising on heavy volume, while big-cap leader NVDA fell into oversold territory (RSI 29) as money rotated within the tech sector. No headlines were provided in today's news feed, so this summary comes only from price and technical data.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日窄幅整固，納斯達克微跌0.1%，標普500指數輕微下跌0.2%，走勢偏向橫行喘息，未見明確轉向訊號。板塊之間資金輪動明顯：日月光（ASX）、AEHR等半導體及設備股繼續放量走高，而龍頭股輝達（NVDA）則回落至超賣區域（RSI 29），反映科技板塊內部資金重新配置。由於今日未有新聞資料提供，以上分析僅根據股價及技術指標數據。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand so they can buy when a good opportunity comes along. Today our cash was below the minimum buy size and the market was flat, so we kept it in reserve and did not force a trade. Being patient like this means we can act quickly when a strong setup appears.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資者預留的現金，以便在出現理想機會時隨時入市。今日組合現金低於最低買入門檻，加上大市橫行，我們選擇保留資金，而非勉強入市。保持耐性、手持現金，待強勢訊號出現時便能果斷出擊。
